Borders

Five border widths and ten corner radii. Every edge and corner in the system is one of these — pick by role, and keep neighbouring components on the same step.

5 widths10 radiiToken-driven

Width

Each line is drawn by its own token — height: var(--border-width-*).
StepTokenValueSampleUse for
1--border-width-11pxHairline — dividers, card and table edges, Tooltip
1-5--border-width-1-51.5pxInput, Select and File Upload edges; Text Link underline on hover
2--border-width-22pxFocus borders, active-nav underline, Button outline
4--border-width-44pxSelected states; Notice’s left bar
8--border-width-88pxDecorative accents, hero callouts

Radius

Each corner is drawn by its own token — border-radius: var(--rounded-*).
StepTokenValueSampleUse for
none--rounded-none0pxSharp corners, dividers
xs--rounded-xs2pxSmall tags
sm--rounded-sm4pxBadge, small controls
md--rounded-md6pxInput, Select, Tooltip, dropdowns
lg--rounded-lg8pxNotice, menu rows, feature cards
xl--rounded-xl12pxTable, panels, large cards
2xl--rounded-2xl16pxHero cards, feature highlights
3xl--rounded-3xl24pxLarge containers
4xl--rounded-4xl32pxLarge pill shapes
full--rounded-full9999pxButton, pills, dots — a circle or an endless pill

The width and the corner a component is built with, drawn with the same two tokens.

Guidelines

✓ Do
  • Use the token: var(--rounded-md), var(--border-width-2).
  • Nest corners: an inner radius is the outer one minus the gap between them, so a 12px card with 8px padding holds a 4px child.
  • Keep controls that sit side by side on the same radius.
✗ Don't
  • Don’t write a raw pixel radius or width, even one that equals a step.
  • Don’t show focus with a border alone — pair it with a focus ring (Shadows).
  • Don’t give an inner box the same radius as its outer one; the corners stop lining up.
